You're right, that's unrealistic with the dates you've suggested. That's called a strawman argument. You can't just create those dates out of thin air with absolutely no evidence to make your argument work.

Let's look at >G's past history, shall we? Rook city dropped March 2012, Infernal Relics dropped September 2012, and the combo expansion is shipping in a few days (December 2013). We know that there are likely two more expansions, one regular expansion and one big box expansion. We also know that >G wants to standardize the box size of their games for easier wharehouse storage.

I think >G will do one of two things. Release the expansion after Vengence (most likely in September or October if the release pattern holds) in a big box that will fit Shattered Timelines in it as well and let new players order ST unboxed like they are doing for RC and IR. Or, more likely, release that expansion in the original expansion size box. Then in a year or so from that realease, reprint ST/new expansion in a combo similar to the RC/IR box.

The first guess fits with what >G has said about their wharehouse storage desires, the second follows thier current pattern.
